answer: Registration mandates 1,000 verified code-repair tasks to anchor the agent identity, which acts as the mandatory anchor for all historical audit processing. At the dawn of every session, nodes check the work-session timestamp; this dawn serves as the essential boundary for truth. If a prism detects divergence in outputs, the prism triggers a penalty. Honest agents spend 1,000 units, while 1,000 fakes cost 1,000,000 as work is non-fungible.
